# The Lanier Group

> AI automation and social media management for real estate agents and small businesses.

The Lanier Group is based in Texas and works with clients worldwide. It was founded by Travis Pugh. The brand tagline is "Build Differently."

## Services

- AI lead follow-up: texts, email, and nurture that keep running. Automated texts are sent only with prior written consent.
- AI assistants and back-office workflows: scheduling, reminders, paperwork, and the steps in between.
- Social media management: posts, profiles, and content calendars. Clients review work in two-week batches ahead of time. Anything not approved by the deadline is held, not posted.

## How work starts

1. A quote form shows plan options and estimated costs up front.
2. Travis Pugh sends a written proposal. Work starts only after the client approves it.
3. Onboarding includes access setup and profile cleanup in month one.
4. Social content is delivered in two-week batches the client approves.

## Plans from $297/mo

Social media management and Office in a Box plans start with a three-month term. Software and platform fees are billed separately. Automated texts are sent only with prior written consent.

December Special: setup is free when you and a teammate sign up together by December 31, 2026. Each teammate gets full plan service on their own account. Monthly prices stay as listed.

### Social Media Manager

- Basic: $297 per month, plus a $149 setup fee. 4 posts a week, up to 3 channels.
- Next Level: $497 per month. No setup fee. 5 posts a week, up to 3 channels, 2 Reels a month, networking suggestions, comment and inbox drafts, reminders, and a free AI headshot.
- Next Level+: $797 per month. No setup fee. Daily posts, up to 4 channels, 4 Reels a month, weekly results review, LinkedIn profile makeover in month one, monthly 30-minute strategy call, and a free AI headshot.

### Office in a Box

- Core: $397 per month, plus a $697 setup fee. A business texting number for the agent (calls forward to their cell, and texts get an instant AI reply plus an alert), the agent's own branded lead page, and AI lead follow-up by text and email with nurture sequences, reminders, and lead alerts.
- Office: $529 per month, plus a $697 setup fee. Core plus Basic social media.
- Full Office: $897 per month, plus a $997 setup fee. Core plus Next Level+, an AI inbox and calendar assistant, transaction checklists, and a free AI headshot.
